facts.control_label: segregation of light vehicles and pedestrians from heavy equipment

setpoint.label: light vehicle exclusion radius from operating haul trucks

facts.site: Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop

response.body: The segregation of light vehicles and pedestrians from heavy equipment shall be provided and maintained for work covered by this standard. The light vehicle exclusion radius from operating haul trucks shall be set at 30 m. This clause applies to activities archived under MOBILE-EQUIPMENT-INTERACTION at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop.
